description: Apache is a widely-used open-source cross-platform web server software.
real_world_incidents: Exploitation of Apache Struts (related technology) led to massive data breaches (e.g., Equifax).

audience_guidance.student: Apache serves websites. If not configured correctly, it might show files it shouldn't.
audience_guidance.developer: Use ServerTokens Prod and ServerSignature Off in the configuration.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check for /server-status, directory listings, and old CVEs based on the version header.
audience_guidance.pentester: Look for misconfigured Alias directives, evaluate HTTP methods enabled (e.g., PUT).
audience_guidance.security_team: Ensure standard secure baseline configs are deployed across all Apache instances.
